name: GladIKnow
instructions: Open https://gladiknow.com, search for {full_name}, open your own record and use the site's opt-out or "Control" link on it. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address. Then press "I've done this".
notes: Removal is a one-click link at the bottom of the page that shows the person's details.
source: Opt-out page listed in The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (thumpersecure/opt-out-manual-2026, public domain). On 2026-10-11 OpenOptOut loaded the opt-out page (no details entered); it says the removal link is at the bottom of each record.
